title: Full text (M3)
brief: Full text screen of goop, opened with f on the offer detail (M2): the original offer text exactly as fetched, shown as untrusted plain text in a framed reader with a dim │ gutter and line numbers, never in goop's voice; header with breadcrumb, source host, fetch time and word count; left markers on the requirement lines goop matched (green match, yellow partial, pink missing) with a legend; search with / (kubern, 1 of 2) typed in a lavender composer, matches shown as goop results in yellow (current one filled); reader scrollbar; no key-hint line under the header: the status line (text focus mode) carries / search, n/N, y copy, o open, a ask goop, scroll keys and esc back.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Reads like one more level of the same offer, with the marked lines indexed on the right; the index column keeps reader lines near 90 columns instead of the full width
